profile.headline: Development Tools Software Engineer @ Intel Corporation | in Electrical Engineering
profile.summary:
At Intel, my role as a Development Tools Software Engineer leverages my proficiency in Calibre DRC & LVS, Python script, design review & analysis to feedback DRC real errors, review & feedback design rule documentation. 

The commitment to innovation and excellence is at the core of my professional ethos. Working alongside talented teams, we've facilitated advancements that underscore my dedication to software engineering and development tools, contributing significantly to Intel's pioneering projects in the technology sphere.

positions.title: Development Tools Software Engineer
positions.description:
Develop Calibre DRC SVRF/TVF for all technologies to support libraries products at Intel .
Contribute to analysis & feedback to fix library cells/spec. Update

positions.title: Embedded System Software Engineer
positions.description: Support embedded software for Abbott Diabetes Care devices

positions.title: CAD Automation Development Engineer
positions.description:
CAD development: DRC & LVS verification rule sets & Device Generator for RFIC processes. (Device & Development Engineering).

Tools: Calibre, Ample, Python, Perl, AWR script in Visual Basic

positions.title: PE Engineer
positions.description: Internal Windows kernel for Notebook/Tablet R & D

positions.title: Electrical Engineer/Firmware Engineer
positions.description:
Firmware development for advanced lighting dimmer systems using
Microchip MPLAB IDE and Freescale CodeWarrior. Develop Mix-Signal TRIAC advanced dimming system, Mix-Signal MOSFET advanced dimming system, and EFD (Electronic Fluorescent Dimmer) 0V to 10V output to control LED drivers

company.name: New Horizons Computer Learning Centers, Dallas TX

positions.title: CAD/EDA/PDK (Process Design Kit) development engineer
positions.description: Develop design rules (DRC/DV), layout versus schematic (LVS/SV) descriptions (rulesets), ESD checker, Parasitic Extraction, and WPG extracts to generate reticles to produce masks

positions.title: Co-op Engineer in Power Supply & Deflection Group
positions.description: Develop software in C language for the system that will auto align a projection television based on digital convergence

positions.title: Co-op Engineer in Digital System Group
positions.description: Complete Design of Power Line CEBus Transceiver  using the SPICE tool to check the circuitry, checking and preparing the hardware part of the project, developing ideas and coding the software stack by using C6805 code for Motorola HC6805 microprocessor.

positions.title: Co-op Engineer in VLSI CAD and Test Development Group
positions.description: Develop (using ViewScript language which developed from ViewLogic) and test the ViewDesign Manager tool which aid design engineers in preparing large hierarchical designs for use by various points tools (simulation, synthesis, timing analysis, etc.)
